issue.title: Assess source fitness for 45 complete Guinea-Bissau physical-gap components
issue.body:
## Scope

Milestone 2 source research under #1202 for the complete immutable ranked family `gap-source-batch:c1a3828584658dbb0c2dd5c8`: all 45 physical-gap component subjects in one fine family, Guinea-Bissau. This is rank 8 among 636 source-fit families meeting the inventory limits. Preserve the complete family and all unknowns; do not narrow to the compatible-source witness or drop siblings. Source fitness and physical authority are unapproved for every component.

The route reports 25 numerical-closure prerequisites, 12 mixed-source-support components, 5 mapped-land-support components, 3 outside the mapped L1 context and 25 unknown. These are inherited source-relative classifications, not causal or dry-land findings. It records 31 nonempty support-closure disagreements requiring separate engineering-first numerical diagnosis.

## Immutable source and exact rosters

Baseline: global actionability routing at immutable commit `6a47b43025d963daf80915c6d219c75ebcc8cd91`. Complete raw JSONL SHA-256 values: families `13d48989d8c1a917e30636dfe7c2b4c15900b82f27353a215020690b1b5dd34f`; components `5815e4f8484e77e414ace6356489052170396569bbaf294bd5755fee1d655a78`; administrative bindings `fd001fca1441f703a0e5d3b4b42ea0c46f1b8c8ad420de42b8561e59799183f6`; land-source-fitness `e189f3ca731cf87433e423f88debce44e666e838fea1a8e57560b1f47f54422c`.

Recorded source family: `gb:GNB:ADM2`; source URL `https://github.com/wmgeolab/geoBoundaries/raw/9469f09/releaseData/gbOpen/GNB/ADM2/geoBoundaries-GNB-ADM2.geojson`; reference year 2017; source vintage `79ffb2ed04702e16f009e4675a8d74ef9bd09d4f`; recipe-metadata vintage `cea80a8aa1f8a55ccb448a8f2ff71e10c49a26f1`. Verify actual source bytes, metadata, license/terms, retrieval lineage, precision and date before drawing conclusions.

The complete component and contact rosters, and complete legacy observation row, are generated from these pinned immutable route bodies below. All four contacts are retained as reference surfaces, not as proof of area coverage or ownership.

## Relationship to #472 and #812

Both are closed research scopes with released claims. Their bodies include the four contact-feature IDs listed below, but their accepted scopes do not include any of these 45 physical-component IDs. #472 accepted a 229-location regional review; its Guinea-Bissau 36-versus-39 sector discrepancy remains unresolved. #812 crosswalked 39 sector subjects and did not approve a regional boundary. Reuse their pinned source and identity findings; do not repeat their sector census or treat shared contact IDs as proof that this physical family was researched. Preserve the unresolved count discrepancy and all cause/water uncertainty.

## Acceptance

1. Reconstruct and retain every exact component geometry from pinned original custody material; bind identity, complete member record, geometry hash, historical observation and current route row. Report mismatches without dropping or substituting members.
2. Pin the complete geometry and metadata for every current contact feature and the original GNB ADM2 product. Reconcile contacts against preserved source observations and #472/#812. For every component, distinguish positive-area intersection, shared edge, point contact and coordinate identity.
3. Assess source role, vintage, coverage/completeness, CRS/datum, precision/accuracy, license and use terms. Obtain independent appropriate physical/water and historical evidence for the complete family; report actual product/version/date, native CRS, resolution or accuracy, license, retrieval time, byte hash, retained bytes or lawful bounded extracts, and per-component coverage.
4. Report per-component results and limits. Keep seasonal/coastal and mangrove water, tides, classification omissions, border uncertainty, source mismatch and temporal mismatch as live questions. Keep all 25 numerical-closure cases engineering-first and unresolved here. Absence of mapped water or an administrative/ecological boundary does not establish dry land, cause or territorial owner.
5. Provide deterministic bounded reproduction and meaningful positive/negative controls for complete roster, source pins, contact joins, classifications and generated outputs. Bind numeric claims to generated scalars and account for every changed file. Preserve original outputs and uncertainty.
6. Deliver source findings, limits and next steps only. No geometry/topology repair, boundary assignment, source approval, physical-cause declaration, territorial claim, live import, release change or publication.

## Verified source details and unresolved relationships

The retained geoBoundaries metadata text records GNB ADM2 as representative of 2017, with 39 units, OpenStreetMap/Wambacher sources, ODbL 1.0, source data updated 2023-01-19, and file built 2023-12-12. The pinned administrative registry exposes both the full geoBoundaries-GNB-ADM2.geojson URL and the simplifiedGeometryGeoJSON URL, while its sha256 field is 8e7d33531e3febc81420d07ceddb1a89c4393139534c6633bcc9330c4a9be5f9. The original source-corpus catalogue records the simplified URL and payload hash 8e7d33531e3febc81420d07ceddb1a89c4393139534c6633bcc9330c4a9be5f9. A separately retained full GeoJSON at data/regional-review/regional-review-1deb892647c1aa26/sources/geoboundaries-9469f09/GNB-geoBoundaries-GNB-ADM2.geojson is 2,384,670 bytes with SHA-256 8839091ee5599651642efc6f8ac65d82a4f40e779bd38debedfd417649bfc680; both products contain the same 39 shape IDs and names but different geometries. Do not conflate the full and simplified products or infer which geometry endpoint fed historical processing.

A read-only exact coordinate comparison of the corpus payload against current Atlas contact geometries found all four geometry pairs differ topologically. Source/current vertex counts are Bolama 283/50, Bubaque 1,069/85, Caravela 952/84, and Uno 981/89. These are vertex-count and coordinate-set diagnostics, not accuracy or impact conclusions; reproduce them in the final packet and explain the selected source-product lineage.

The four current contact IDs map in data/geography/part-9.json to Setor de Uno (...B44985576134462), Setor de Caravela (...B59106895169358), Setor de Bolama (...B77006902429960), and Setor de Bubaque (...B98496568253651). The retained legacy Caravela observation records feature hash 99987a255b44f3e5fcbc4feb3a6e29ea99cd6fad50da14dc468bcf410387884a and original_parent_id=framework:province:bolama:08258e19a5c1. Treat that as a recorded parent mapping whose administrative interpretation remains to be assessed; do not upgrade it to a legal or authoritative parent conclusion.
